titolo: How to install Ollama and run AI on your own PC, with real speed numbers
descr: Install Ollama on Windows, download a 4B model and chat offline. Every command, what you should see, and the speed we measured with a GPU and without one.
paragrafi: Ollama runs AI models on your own computer. Your prompts stay on your machine, you need no account, and the model keeps working without the internet.
Install it with the official command from ollama.com, then download a model with ollama pull. We used Qwen3.5 4B, about 3 GB on disk.
On a Radeon RX 7900 XTX it wrote about 133 tokens per second. With a Ryzen 9 9950X3D alone it wrote about 15.
Use ollama ps to check that it runs on the GPU. The model took 8.1 GB in memory, far more than its file size.
To free your disk, remove a model with ollama rm.
perche: Names ending in cloud do not run on your computer, and small models make mistakes, so check important answers.
